sourceRefs.evidence: IAS 12 separates current tax, deferred tax assets/liabilities and temporary differences; standard history includes May 2023 Pillar Two exception.

IAS 12 paragraphs 34-36: unused tax-loss/credit deferred-tax asset recognition requires probable usable taxable profit and appropriate entity/tax authority/timing; prior losses demand stronger support.
2023 amendment introduced temporary exception for deferred tax related to Pillar Two and targeted disclosure; accounting version must be PIT-dated.

mechanism: Separate reported income-tax expense, current-tax payable, deferred-tax recognition and actual tax cash settlements. An effective-tax-rate level alone cannot identify recurring tax efficiency or usable interest tax shields.

falsificationAndAlternatives.hypothesis: Low reported effective tax rate signals durable cash-tax efficiency.
falsificationAndAlternatives.counterexample: Illustrative pretax income 100, current-tax expense 20 and deferred-tax benefit 10 imply income-tax expense 10 and ETR 10%; current tax remains 20, cash paid remains UNKNOWN without payment statement.
falsificationAndAlternatives.alternative: Deferred recognition/timing, nonrecurring credits or geographic mix can produce the low ETR.
falsificationAndAlternatives.invalidWhen: Tax reconciliation, current/deferred split, nonrecurring effects or payment vintage unavailable.

falsificationAndAlternatives.hypothesis: An existing deferred-tax asset proves that debt interest produces a fully usable current-period tax shield.
falsificationAndAlternatives.counterexample: IAS 12 recognition is an accounting assessment of future deductible differences/losses; interest deductibility, local tax-law limits, timing and same-entity taxable income are separate conditions.
falsificationAndAlternatives.alternative: Tax losses, group relief restrictions, interest deduction limits, and future reversals may change realizability.
falsificationAndAlternatives.invalidWhen: Jurisdiction, taxable entity, usable income and tax-law-vintage not independently proven.

falsificationAndAlternatives.hypothesis: A decrease in statutory-tax-adjusted WACC is a known economic improvement.
falsificationAndAlternatives.counterexample: Illustrative debt weight 0.40 and pretax debt cost 0.05 with 0.20 statutory tax rate give 0.004 (40 basis points) assumed tax-shield WACC benefit; if shield usability UNKNOWN the 40bp is an assumption, not observed evidence.
falsificationAndAlternatives.alternative: Debt pricing, leverage risk and equity-cost changes can dominate or offset tax-shield effects.
falsificationAndAlternatives.invalidWhen: Debt spread, weight, tax shield, equity-risk inputs or PIT version absent.

falsificationAndAlternatives.hypothesis: Deferred tax asset growth is unambiguously good news.
falsificationAndAlternatives.counterexample: A recognized asset can face recoverability uncertainty; IAS 12 requires prospective taxable-profit support, and later realized profit cannot retroactively prove historical support.
falsificationAndAlternatives.alternative: Temporary-difference timing, loss carryforwards, impairment/recognition adjustments, tax-planning opportunities.
falsificationAndAlternatives.invalidWhen: Recognition evidence and tax-law validity unavailable.

accountingGuards: Income tax expense in profit or loss is not necessarily the sum of every tax item disclosed; tax recognized in OCI/equity and discontinued operations require classification.
Current-tax expense is not identical to actual cash tax paid; payables, prepayments and settlements must be separately observed.
Negative or near-zero pretax earnings make effective-tax-rate ratios unstable; preserve numerator and denominator and mark percentage UNKNOWN where unsuitable.
Accounting recognition of deferred tax assets does not itself prove contemporaneous cash tax relief or interest deductibility.
Do not use present-day IAS 12 version or later amended filings as historical first-known.
antiBias: OOS/walk-forward only after actual historical data and frozen cohorts
selection bias including loss-making and delisted firms
no look-ahead, snooping or multiple testing
no factor double count with D07-18 WACC and D07-06 leverage
transaction costs/liquidity/regime only at future strategy evaluation

maturityDecision.reason: Mechanism, countermechanisms, concrete synthetic falsification and PIT source contract established; Taiwan physical PIT evidence not yet proven, so L3 prohibited.

exactNext: Map Taiwan general-industry issuer current/deferred tax, cash taxes, unused losses/credits, tax reconciliation and tax-law vintages from actual MOPS filing versions across >=2 issuers and >=2 dates; preserve firstKnownAt and revisions; do not consume tax shield in D07-18 until legally and empirically supported.
